title: Kagamine Len — Sending An Extra Special Heart〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Looks like we're all here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You said you wanted to discuss something important. Were you talking about...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to discuss what we'll be doing for Valentine's Day, since it's coming up soon.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We've already decided to put on a show during the day of, but we haven't really hammered out the details yet.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We have to come up with a set list and effects... It's a special occasion, so it would be nice to do something a little different.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Different...
What if we threw in some Valentine's Day activities in between songs?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I bet everyone would love that♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I agree.
But what would count as a Valentine's Day activity?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Something involving chocolates is what immediately comes to mind for me...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Right...
I am thinking about including a few songs about chocolate in the set list, but other ideas would also be nice to have.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
What else is central to Valentine's Day...?
Confessing to someone you care about?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, what about hearts?
We could do something involving those?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, that'd be great! And really cute!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Not only is it a wonderful idea, it also suits who we are as idols.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I like it as well!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, let's come up with an activity involving hearts, shall we?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hearts... Hearts...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, we can have a contest to see who can draw the most hearts in a short amount of time!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Drawing lots of hearts together does sound like fun.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, since we're doing this, I feel that we should do something for the audience.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, good point! We shouldn't be the ones having all the fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The audience...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, what if we made hearts for them?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If we made hearts for them?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, we'll take turns doing heart-themed poses for them♪
We can even make it a contest to see who receives the best response.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that's an excellent idea!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'd also like to see your poses!
I'm getting excited just thinking about them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, making hearts for everyone does sound like a wonderful idea♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And it has a Valentine's Day feel to it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we go with that?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Excellent.
Then, let's start coming up with the set list next...
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Thank goodness we were able to figure out the plan for our show.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Now we just need to practice as much as we can until the day of, and work on our activity...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Making hearts for the audience...
What kind of pose should I do?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I can use just my fingers, or my hands...
If I used both my hands, then I could use my fingers in different ways.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And place them in some unique positions as I pose.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Do I make a heart in front of my face and smile... Or in front of my chest and smile... I feel like somewhere near my face would look the cutest...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I should give this some more thought.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're supposed to make hearts, so I sorta just naturally started thinking about cute poses...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But Miku and Rin are gonna be way better at that. I mean, these are the kinds of poses they would do.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Everyone would probably like it if I did something in a bit of a different direction.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that should make it feel more fun and unique. So, let's go with that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, I think I've got a plan.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Based on how everyone sees me, I should be going for something stylish.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
My pose won't just be cute.
I'll also be trying to look cool and elegant...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll keep working on it, but it might be a good idea for me to ask for an outside opinion too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... Who knows a lot about striking good poses...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I guess Shizuku is the best person to ask.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll go see if she can help.
